fields.description: CSD has no supplier API (see tender/CSD-API-Findings.md), so this inventory is user-maintained with the report PDF attached

fields.label: Reference
fields.description: e.g. the CSD MAAA number, TCS PIN, CIDB grading designation

fields.label: Expiry Date
fields.description: User-entered, read off the certificate itself - uploads are scans and an expiry date cannot be read from an image deterministically. Required for every artifact type that expires; the expiry sweep and bid gather-lists run off this field

fields.label: Renewal Window (days)
fields.description: Days before expiry at which the artifact turns Amber (default 30)

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Computed from valid_until - Green (valid), Amber (inside the renewal window), Expired
